//: The settings of check:architecture (scripts/check/architecture.mjs), the mechanical half of docs/ARCHITECTURE-RULES.md. Until enforceFrom the runner only reports and exits 0 (one week to tune the checks against false positives, owner-approved 11 Nov 2026); from that date it fails on findings beyond config/architecture-baseline.json, on stale baseline entries and on malformed arch-ok markers. Each check's scope is a list of path prefixes (a prefix ending in / is a folder); vendored, minified and build files are never read. noBaseline: checks that must be clean (no baseline). markerScanExclude: files that mention arch-ok as text (the checker and its tests), not as markers.

C3.//: src/ was in scope; its modules moved into packages/map/src/ (rf9-mapapp, 12 Nov 2026) and are listed one by one so the scope stays what it was. The rest of packages/map is not in scope yet: it has 12 findings (escapeHtml, slugify and the like in app/, src/app/, src/election/, src/renderer/), listed in the rf9-mapapp landing note as follow-up.

extraVocabulary.//: The candidate outcomes, held here until a registry holds them. The voting systems and the kinds of election are read from the election-types registry (data/registries/election-types.json, REG-2) since 12 Nov 2026.

ignoreRoutes.//: Endpoints that are not the records API v1 serves, with why.
ignoreRoutes.auth: sign-in status for contributors (Cloudflare Access), not a public answer
ignoreRoutes.contributions: contributors' submissions and their schema, behind sign-in

modifiers.//: Per route, parameters that shape an answer a variant already selects (rf9-ui, 12 Nov 2026). graph related=1: the entity variant's own modifier (its summary: related=1 adds reverse and source statements). elections slug: the record a view=record answer is about (the handler reads slug, else key); v1.js's record variant names only view, so the request to rf9-api-storage is to add slug to its when, after which this entry goes.
